title: Historical RTEC AAP compilation workflow inferred from the 2022 package
summary: The source package demonstrates a staged AAP/EEO analysis process that moves from employee/personnel inputs through workforce/job-group/activity analysis, labor-market availability, incumbency comparisons, goal setting, narrative good-faith efforts, complaint/investigation records, and binder assembly.

stages.stage: Compile external labor statistics and internal/external placement weights
Determine availability for females/minorities, veterans, and individuals with disabilities
Compare incumbency to availability and establish annual placement goals
Write narrative descriptions, good-faith efforts, goals and timetables
Assemble indexed binder sections, ads/brochures, and Kentucky certification material
stages.gap: Sample ads/brochures and Commonwealth of Kentucky certification source files were referenced by the binder index but were not included in this upload.

controls: Employee-level EEO and identity data should remain restricted from generalized process knowledge.
Snapshot/effective period must be kept distinct from later file-edit dates.
Source numbers should not be silently corrected; calculation issues require a separately reviewed correction.
automation_candidates: Generate future AAP packages from a validated restricted roster plus versioned job-group mappings and current labor-market data.
Run deterministic arithmetic/percentage consistency checks before narrative generation or goal-setting.
Produce binder/index sections automatically from the source manifest.
Maintain a version-to-version diff of workforce composition, availability, goals, hires, terminations, and good-faith narratives.
Keep Title VII/EEO complaint case data in a separate restricted case store while exposing only aggregate counts to the AAP compiler.
provenance: all plan source records in source-manifest.json
